name: Tsukino Yuzuha
source:
Honor student at Hoshinomiya Academy, same school as protagonist.
On the outside, she acts amiable, but due to the pressure of being an honor student, she turns into an outrageous mesugaki.
The only time she shows her true colors is in front of her onii-chan.
She loves video games and anime, probably because she inherited her otaku brother's blood.
